title: How to get the first day of the week for any date
task: Snap any date back to its Monday (or Sunday) — for weekly grouping and reports.
explanation: WEEKDAY mode 2 gives Monday=1 through Sunday=7 — exactly how many days into the week the date is — so subtracting it and adding 1 lands on that week's Monday: Wednesday July 22 → Monday July 20. Grouping data by this value (a helper column feeding SUMIF or a pivot) is the standard way to build weekly totals. The end of the week is the same result +6, and next Monday is +7.
